description: Blocks agents from running git commit or git push.

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const c=(JSON.parse(d).tool_input||{}).command||'';if(/\bgit\s+(commit|push)\b/.test(c)){console.error('Blocked: agents must never commit or push. The user does this manually.');process.exit(2)}})"
